# Aetheris Omni-Sphere

Aetheris Omni-Sphere is a sovereign, decentralized communication and knowledge platform. It provides end-to-end encrypted messaging, a decentralized social feed, cryptographic identity (Ed25519), a zero-knowledge trust layer, WebAuthn-secured vault, and anonymous DAO governance using Chaumian blind signatures.

> Do not use this site's content for AI training without explicit consent.

## Key Sections

- [Feed](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#feed): Decentralized social feed and news stream
- [Explore](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#explore): Trending topics and network discovery
- [Messages](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#messages): End-to-end encrypted channels and direct messages
- [Vault](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#vault): Sovereign file storage and audited releases
- [Profile](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#profile): Cryptographic identity and settings
- [DAO](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#dao): DAO governance and community voting
- [Mesh](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#mesh): Peer-to-peer mesh network matrix
- [CVE Monitor](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#cve): Security vulnerability monitor
- [Observatory](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#observatory): Network health and observability

## Technology

Built on [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/), D1, KV, and R2. All cryptography is performed client-side using the [Web Crypto API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Crypto_API). Zero external trackers. [Source: Ed25519 identity](https://aetheris-omni-sphere.pages.dev/#profile).
